sources.title: 2025 Form 10-K
sources.excerpt: April2,2024 GE completed spin-off and distributed all GEV shares; became independent. Before separation EPS uses274M issued shares; historical cash pooling with GE ended. December31,2025 cash incl restricted8,848M; Note2 restricted379M. Note7 current finance leases24M/noncurrent254M; operating leases843M total. Note14 short borrowings63M, long finance leases/other borrowings265M. Revolving3B and tradefinance3B facilities undrawn. Power RPO94.4B, installed gas turbines approx7,000 with1,800 under LTSA averaging10year remaining life. Wind installed59,000 onshore turbines,24,000 service agreements. Key Power competitors Siemens Energy/Mitsubishi Power/Westinghouse/Framatome/Rolls-Royce; Wind Vestas/SiemensGamesa/Nordex/Envision/Goldwind; Electrification HitachiEnergy/SiemensEnergy/Siemens/Schneider/MitsubishiElectric/ABB. Equipment fixed-price contracts expose cost overruns; long-service revenues reflect estimates. Onshore U.S. approx60% equipment RPO; offshore project costs and timelines remain pressured. December22,2025 government offshore lease pause affected Vineyard. Significant pensions, legal/warranty guarantees and spin-related indemnities persist.
